title: Massons Trichrome Staining Protocol
author: Jeff Hodgin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.56ug9ew

steps.title: Deparaffinize and Rehydrate Slides
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes to remove paraffin and rehydrate the tissue sections.

substeps.instruction: Wash in running tap water for 3 minutes

steps.title: Mordant Treatment
steps.instruction: Place slides in Bouins solution for one hour in a 55-56 degree oven, or overnight at room temperature if needed.

steps.title: Remove Mordant
steps.instruction: Wash well in running water for 5-10 minutes or until the yellow color is gone.

steps.title: Nuclear Staining
steps.instruction: Stain slides in Weigerts Hematoxylin for 10-20 minutes (usually 10 minutes).

steps.title: Rinse Slides
steps.instruction: Wash well in running water for 10 minutes, then rinse with distilled water.

steps.title: Cytoplasmic Staining
steps.instruction: Place slides in Biebrich Scarlet-Acid Fuchsin for 5-10 minutes, then rinse in distilled water.

steps.title: Differentiation
steps.instruction: Place slides in the Phosphomolybdic-Phosphotungstic Acid Solution in a plastic coplin jar for 10-15 minutes or until collagen fibers are no longer red.

steps.title: Collagen Staining
steps.instruction: Place slides in Aniline Blue solution for 10 minutes, then rinse in distilled water.

steps.title: Acid Rinse
steps.instruction: Place slides in 1% Acetic acid for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Dehydrate and Clear Slides
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes to dehydrate and clear the slides before mounting.

steps.title: Mount and Coverslip
steps.instruction: Mount the slides and apply coverslips.

substeps.instruction: Apply 1 drop of mounting medium to the slides
